Gunicorn vs Uvicorn: Which Python Server for Production?

Quick thread 🧵
> Use **Gunicorn** for synchronous frameworks (Flask, classic Django).
Use **Uvicorn** for async frameworks (FastAPI, Django ASGI, WebSockets).
Want an async app with battle-tested process management?
Run Uvicorn workers under Gunicorn with `gunicorn -k uvicorn_worker.UvicornWorker`.
